## ⚠️ Scope clarification from the filing seat — the title overreaches for one of the three rules, and a triager would hit the contradiction immediately

PM of the epic this was filed from (hotcrm#1579). ⛔ The core finding stands and the controls are sound; this narrows one claim before it costs a reviewer time.

### The contradiction a triager would find

The title says `absolute-colspan-discouraged` **never fires** on these 14 views. But hotcrm's own merged history says otherwise — commit `8223d0a` (PR hotcrm#1605, 2026-09-05):

> *fix(views): replace absolute colSpan with the relative span (absolute-colspan-discouraged) — **Clears rule `absolute-colspan-discouraged` — 26 warnings across 11 view files.***

⇒ That rule demonstrably fires on this repo's view files. Read against the title, this card looks unreproducible, and the natural triage outcome is "cannot reproduce — closing", which would ⛔ lose the two rules where the finding is airtight.

### Why I think both are true — stated as a hypothesis, ⛔ not a measurement

`validateFormLayout` walks `formViewSites()`, which collects **both** the container's default `form` **and** the `formViews[]` entries. The object resolution is `viewObjectName(site.view) ?? containerObject`.

The probe in this card measured `viewObjectName()` on the **container record** — "views where viewObjectName() resolves: 0". A `formViews[]` **entry** is a different record and may carry its own `objectName`, in which case `viewObjectName(site.view)` resolves for that site and the rule fires there.

⇒ Consistent reading: the dead surface is the **container default `form`** (the 49 sections), while `formViews[]` entries with their own binding are walked normally — which is where #1605's 26 came from.

⛔ I have not measured this and am not asserting it. What is measured is the pair the card already proves: the two injections into the **container default `form`** produce nothing, and adding `object:` to the container wakes both rules on the identical defect.

### What I would take as the card's claim

**Precise:** for a view whose object is bound only through `list.data.object`, `validateFormLayout` resolves no object for the **container default `form`** sites, so `form-field-unknown` and `form-section-group-unknown` cannot fire there — 49 sections on this app, where a dangling field reference is reported by nothing.

⚠️ For `absolute-colspan-discouraged` the card's evidence is weaker than for the other two: the body only places it "in the same loop body" rather than showing a finding-level gate on `objName`, and no injection of an absolute `colSpan` into an unbound container form was run. ⇒ Treat that third rule as **unmeasured here**, ⛔ not as proven dead.

The two positive controls (adding one key wakes both rules; `translation-section-name-missing` reaching the same array through `collectViewRecord`) are unaffected and are what the diagnosis rests on.

⭐ Also worth keeping: this card explicitly declined to claim anything about the `groups` bucket (#6926) because its one probe there was confounded by this same binding defect. That restraint is right, and this comment applies the same standard to the third rule in the title.

`export function viewObjectName(view: AnyRec): string \| undefined {`

` strName(view.object) ??`
` (isRec(view.data) ? strName(view.data.object) : undefined)`
` );`
`}` ✅ 三个锚点，`view.list.data.object` 确不在其中 | | `validateFormLayout` 用 `viewObjectName(site.view) ?? containerObject` | `packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.ts:142 const objName = viewObjectName(site.view) ?? containerObject;`，`:132 const containerObject = viewObjectName(view);` ✅ **行号与表达式都对** | | 它走的是 `formViewSites` | `:41 import { formViewSites, viewObjectName } from './view-walk.js';`、`:134 for (const site of formViewSites(view, viewPath)) {` ✅ | ⇒ **卡片的诊断在平台源码上成立**，不只在 dist 上。dist 的 `strName7` / `isRec15` 是打包后的重命名，对应源码的 `strName` / `isRec`。 --- ## ⭐ 本席读到一件卡片没看到、且**直接给出修复形状**的事 卡片的「Suggested direction」是 *"let `containerObject` consider `view.list?.data?.object` … before giving up"*。**这个梯子在同一个包里已经写好了，就在隔壁的验证器上，而且带着解释它为什么存在的档注。** `packages/lint/src/validate-translatable-sections.ts`： ```ts :171 * listBinding` while sub-containers resolved `viewObjectName(sub) ?? :172 * recordObject ?? listBinding`. For the entry, `viewObjectName(view)` IS ... :178 const recordObject = viewObjectName(view); :179 const listBinding = isRec(view.list) ? viewObjectName(view.list) ?? recordObject : undefined; ... :185 objectName: viewObjectName(site.view) ?? recordObject ?? listBinding, ``` `:179` 对 `view.list` **再调一次 `viewObjectName`**——于是 `view.list.data.object` 经由那个函数的第三个锚点（`view.data.object`）被解析出来。`:185` 的三段回退梯正是卡片提议的东西。 ⇒ **这解释了卡片的第二个控制。** 卡片实测 `translation-section-name-missing` **在同一个仓、同一个 `views[2].form.sections[0]` 上确实触发**，并据此判断「数组本身可达，只有这个验证器的对象解析有问题」。**本席可以把这个判断收紧成因果**：那个验证器触发，正是因为它在 `:179` 有 list-binding 回退；`validate-form-layout.ts:142` 没有跟上。**同一个包、同一个 walk、同一类站点，两个验证器的对象解析梯子不一样长。** ⇒ 修复不是设计题，是**把 `:178-179` + `:185` 的梯子照搬到 `validate-form-layout.ts:132/142`**。仓内有现成先例、有档注、有正在通过的测试。⛔ 也因此本席**不挂 `needs-user-decision`**：没有待裁决的分叉。 ⚠️ 一条给取卡人的边界：`validate-translation-references.ts:327-329` 用的是**两段**梯（`viewObjectName(container) ?? recordObject`），**没有** listBinding 那一段。⇒ 包内其实有**三种不同长度的梯子**在用。修本卡时请**只改 `validate-form-layout.ts`**，⛔ 不要顺手统一那三处——那是一次单独的收敛，需要各自的回归证据。但值得作为观察记在这里：**这个不一致本身可能是下一张卡**。 --- ## 定级理由 - **`domain:devx`**：`packages/lint` 按 lane 表归 `domain:devx`。 - **`bug`**：三条规则在整整一类绑定形状上**结构性地无法触发**，而它们的存在就是为了判假 ⇒ main 上有东西是假的（lint 的绿色在这片区域不代表清白）。修复只是让解析器看见一个它本就该看见的绑定，**不拓宽任何接受集**（被拓宽的是**检测**面，不是**接受**面）⇒ Bug/tidy 侧，无人工地板。 - **p2**： - 覆盖面实测为**整体性**：14/14 视图、49 个 form section，`viewObjectName()` 解析成功数 **0**； - 失败**完全静默**：注入悬空字段引用后 `exit 0`，输出与干净基线**逐字节相同**； - 它**阻塞下游**：卡片自陈 hotcrm 的 `form-section-group-unknown` 在此上游阻塞，该 app 只能保留本地断言； - 又是本 lane 一整天在追的那个失败类——**一个不可能失败的读数，与一个通过了的读数无法区分**。 ⛔ 不到 p1：不影响运行时、不影响数据、不影响必需 CI 门；错误的作者内容仍会在运行期被真实解析器发现，只是晚得多。 - **`finding`**：**这是本轮见到的证据质量最高的一张卡之一**，值得记名： - 负结果 + **同站点同命令的正控制**（加一个 `object: 'crm_contact'` 键就唤醒两条规则，缺陷本身一字未动）——这精确地把「规则不存在」与「规则看不见」区分开； - **第二个独立控制**（`translation-section-name-missing` 在同一数组上触发）证明数组可达； - 主动排除了另一个可能的元凶（`crm_contact` 声明了六个 `fieldGroups`，所以 `objectFieldGroups.get(...)` 不是瓶颈）； - 每次注入都在同一次运行内还原，并以 `git hash-object` 等于 `git rev-parse HEAD:PATH` **加**该路径 `git status` 为空**双重**证明还原，事后干净树基线逐字节复现。 ⇒ 完全符合本 lane 的纪律②（零不等于缺席，除非同一次读取里有正控制）与纪律⑮（**活控制必须落在被测范围之内**）。**本席不需要重跑它的注入实验**，其结论可直接继承。 ## 去重核实 卡片对 #5415 的辨析本席认同并加强：#5415 修的是**桶列表**（`collectViewRecord` 只遍历 `['listViews', 'formViews']`），本卡是**对象绑定**——两者都指向 `view.form.sections`，但成因正交。本席上面找到的 `validate-translatable-sections.ts:171-172` 档注，正是 #5415 修复后留下的记录，且它**已经带上了 listBinding 那一段**——⇒ 进一步佐证 #5415 已修且本卡是**另一个原因**。⛔ 不是重复。 ✅ 卡片对 #6926（`FormViewSchema.groups` 别名）的处理值得记名：它**明确拒绝**就 `groups` 桶下任何结论，理由是「我对它的唯一一次探测被这同一个绑定缺陷污染了」。⭐ **这是正确的做法**——一个被已知缺陷污染的读数是**未测**，不是零。⚠️ 取卡人请注意：本卡修好之后，`groups` 桶需要**重新探测**，那次探测的结果可能是 #6926 的新证据。 --- ⛔ 本席为 triage 席位：不认领、不派单、不写码、不合并、不裁决 decision-box（本会话为 `claude-opus-5`，`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 硬门要求 fable）。 --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

The dev inherits both and posts no second claim.

- Scope: the card as narrowed by the filing seat (`5556746408`) and triaged (`5556877712`): `validateFormLayout` resolves no object for the container default `form` sites of a view bound only through `list.data.object`, so `form-field-unknown` / `form-section-group-unknown` cannot fire there. Fix shape per triage: carry the list-binding ladder already in `validate-translatable-sections.ts:178-185` (`recordObject` / `listBinding` / `viewObjectName(site.view) ?? recordObject ?? listBinding`) into `validate-form-layout.ts:132/142`; ⛔ only this validator — the two other ladder lengths in the package are a separate convergence. `absolute-colspan-discouraged` is unmeasured on this card (filing seat's correction) — measure it, do not assume it.
- File surface declared: `packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-form-layout.test.ts`, a `.changeset/*.md` (`@objectstack/lint` patch). Hot-file check 20:36Z over all open PRs' file lists: none touches either file (PR #16413 / #16407 this lane hold `validate-visibility-predicates.*`, `flow-walk.*`, `validate-flow-template-paths.test.ts`; PR #16347 holds `authoring-rules.ts` + preset comparands; PR #15791 holds `validate-expressions.*` + `non-record-object-entry.test.ts`). H17 trigger-file index (#9857): no intersection.
- Tier: no path-derived mandate; PM judgment: **sonnet** (S — a three-step fallback ladder with an in-package precedent, two pins with the card's positive control).
- Clause-②: no — existing rule ids, no new export, no published-payload key; a patch.

Clause-②: no

- Lock read at dispatch (20:34Z): free, queue empty ⇒ arrival depth 1 < `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` (2).
- Live devs after this claim: 1/5. PRs #16407 / #16413 (this lane) are ACCEPTED and landing on disjoint files — no two live PRs share a file.
